versions.content: If the configuration parameter DemOBDEventDisplacement is set to TRUE all emission related events with the following conditions shall not be con- sidered during the displacement mechanism and shall not displaced from error mem- ory: Event old is emission related AND (Event old triggers MIL indicator OR (Event old holds legislative Freeze Frame AND has equal or higher priority) OR Pending-DTC==1)
